questions.question: What is the theme of the India Innovation Summit 2024?

options.text: Healthcare Innovations for a Sustainable Future

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pioneering Solutions to End TB.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare, Anupriya Patel, inaugurated the India Innovation Summit 2024 with the theme “Pioneering Solutions to End TB.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The India Innovation Summit 2024 aims to fast-track India’s progress in eliminating TB by 2025.**
 
• The event was jointly organized by the Department of Health Research (DHR), ICMR, and the Central TB Division (CTD).
 
• Over 1,200 participants from academia, industry, and research showcased more than 200 healthcare innovations.
 
• The summit highlighted advancements such as the mBPaL treatment regimen, AI-based TB detection tools, and handheld X-ray devices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National TB Elimination Program (NTEP)__

 __
 
• India aims to eliminate TB by 2025 under this initiative.
 
• TB cases in India hit a record 26.07 lakh in 2024.
 
• TB incidence has declined by 17.7% since 2015.
 
 
 
• Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana__
 __
 
• Provides financial aid to TB patients for nutrition.
 
• Assistance doubled to ₹1,000 per month from November 2024.
 
 
 
• TB Mukt Bharat – 100 Days Intensified Campaign__
 __
 
• Launched on 7th December 2024, covering 455 high-priority districts.
 
• Focuses on early diagnosis and prompt treatment.
 
• The report will be released on World TB Day in March 2025.
 
 
 
• Other Disease Elimination Targets__
 
 
• India aims to eliminate Leprosy, Lymphatic Filariasis, Measles, Rubella, and Kala-azar within five years.
 
• ICMR has validated indigenous diagnostic tools to support these efforts.

questions.question: Which country hosted the 24th Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) Meeting of the Council of Ministers?

• 
 
The **24th meeting of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) Council of Ministers** was held **virtually**.

 
 
•

questions.question: Where was the 15th BRICS Trade Ministers' Meeting held?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Brazil__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• India pushes for removal of export controls among BRICS nations.

questions.question: What is the theme of the 10th Raisina Dialogue 2025?

options.text: Transforming the World: A New Vision

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Kālachakra – People, Peace and Planet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi to to inaugurate 10th edition of Raisina Dialogue in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **10th edition** of the **Raisina Dialogue** will be inaugurated by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in New Delhi.
 
• **Christopher Luxon**, Prime Minister of **New Zealand**, will be the **Chief Guest** and deliver the keynote address.
 
• The **theme** of this year's dialogue is "**Kālachakra – People, Peace and Planet**".
 
• The **Raisina Dialogue** will run for **three days** from March 17 to 19, 2025.
 
• The event will cover **six thematic pillars**:
 
 
• **Politics Interrupted: Shifting Sands and Rising Tides**
 
• **Resolving the Green Trilemma: Who, Where, and How**
 
• **Digital Planet: Agents, Agencies and Absences**
 
• **Powerplay: The New Global Game of Influence**
 
• **Global Governance 2.0: Reforming International Institutions**
 
• **The Future of Conflict: Redefining War and Peace**
 
 
 
• Around **125 countries** are expected to participate in the dialogue.
 
• The **Raisina Dialogue** is India’s premier conference focused on **geopolitics** and **geoeconomics**.

questions.question: What is the theme of the World Sustainable Development Summit 2025?

options.text: Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions
Climate Action for Global Equality: A Dire Need for Change
Innovations for a Sustainable Future, for a Sustainable Planet

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The theme of the World Sustainable Development Summit 2025 was "Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme focused on accelerating sustainable development and finding innovative climate solutions through global partnerships.**
 
• The summit was organized by The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) and was attended by key leaders from India and other nations.
 
• It emphasized India's role in global climate action, especially through initiatives like the International Solar Alliance (ISA) and Mission LiFE.
 
• The summit also advocated for greater financial and technological cooperation from developed nations to support the Global South.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA)__ **

 __
 
• **Formed in 2015 to promote solar energy and collaboration among solar-rich countries.**
 
• **India has taken a leading role in promoting the global shift to renewable energy.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Mission LiFE__ **
 __
 
• **Launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi to address climate change and promote a sustainable lifestyle.**
 
• **Focuses on low-carbon lifestyles and environmental sustainability.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Global South__ **
 
 
• **Refers to developing countries in Asia, Africa, and Latin America.**
 
• **Focuses on enhancing cooperation and support for climate adaptation in these regions.**

questions.question: What is the theme of the 9th Asia Economic Dialogue (AED) 2025 which is being held in Pune, Maharashtra?

options.text: Economic Resilience and Resurgence in an Era of Fragmentation
Innovation and Growth in the Asia-Pacific Region

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Economic Resilience and Resurgence in an Era of Fragmentation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 9th Asia Economic Dialogue (AED) is being held in Pune, Maharashtra.**
 
• It is the annual flagship ‘Track 1.5 Dialogue’ on geo-economics, organized by the Ministry of External Affairs in collaboration with Pune International Centre.
 
• The theme for AED 2025 is “Economic Resilience and Resurgence in an Era of Fragmentation.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The dialogue will explore key topics in geo-economics, including Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation.
 
• Economic imperatives of cyber security will be discussed as a major area of concern.
 
• The Blue Economy and its relevance in the Indian Ocean Region and beyond will be highlighted.
 
• It aims to address global economic fragmentation and suggest actionable pathways for resilience and resurgence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Asia Economic Dialogue (AED)__

 __
 
• MEA’s annual geo-economic conference addressing regional and global economic challenges.
 
• A 'Track 1.5 Dialogue' meaning it involves both government officials and experts from various fields.
 
• Focuses on economic policy, trade, and digital advancements affecting Asia and the world.
 
 
 
• Key Focus Areas of AED 2025__
 __
 
• Geopolitical and geo-economic shifts in the global economy.
 
• Cybersecurity and AI’s impact on economic structures.
 
• The significance of the Blue Economy in global trade and sustainability.
 
 
 
• Pune International Centre__
 
 
• A key collaborator for AED, focusing on policy research and global economic dialogues.
 
• Brings together academicians, policymakers, and industry leaders for policy discussions.

questions.question: The 85th session of the All India Presiding Officers’ Conference (AIPOC) will be organized at which place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Patna__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The 85th session of the All India Presiding Officers’ Conference (AIPOC) is being organized in Patna, Bihar, on 20th and 21st January 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__

• It is being hosted in Bihar after 43 years, with the last conference held in 1982.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Where was the International Conference "Shaping the Energy Future: Challenges and Opportunities" (SEFCO-2025) held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dehradun.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The International Conference “Shaping the Energy Future: Challenges and Opportunities” (SEFCO-2025) was held at CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum, Dehradun.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **SEFCO-2025 is an international conference organized by CSIR-IIP, Dehradun, from April 23 to 25, 2025.**
 
• **The conference focuses on the challenges and opportunities in the energy and chemical sectors, with the theme “Catalysing a Sustainable Future with Affordable Energy and Chemicals.”**
 
• The conference features talks from national and international experts in the energy sector.
 
• More than 300 delegates from national and international organizations are attending the conference.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum (CSIR-IIP)__

 __
 
• Located in Dehradun, India.
 
• Part of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• Focuses on energy and petroleum research and technological innovations.
 
 
 
• SEFCO Conference__
 
 
• The conference is organized annually by students and young scientists at CSIR-IIP.
 
• The first edition of SEFCO was held in 2017, and the current edition is the 7th edition.

questions.question: Where is the electric energy conference ‘Elecs Korea 2025’ being held?
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is ​Seoul**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Elecs Korea 2025** started in **Seoul** on **Feb 12, 2025**, showcasing advanced **electric power technologies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Hosted by the Ministry of Trade, Industry, and Energy**, the event runs for **three days at COEX convention center**.
 
• **Around 260 companies** from South Korea and abroad are participating, displaying **heavy electrical equipment, smart grid solutions, and renewable energy technologies**.
 
• **AI applications in electric power technologies** are a key focus to improve efficiency.
 
• **Industry Minister Ahn Duk-geun set a record export target of $16.2 billion** for heavy electrical equipment in 2025.
 
• In **2024, South Korea’s heavy electrical equipment exports reached a record $15.6 billion**.
 
• **The government will support the sector with R&D investments and tax benefits** to boost global competitiveness.
